Grain size analysis test on RSM-a soil; apparatus: sieve analysis (Soiltest CL 370C shaker; 8 inch sieves). Recorded: percent finer by weight vs grain size mm (average of several analyses).

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple"}
The measurements of this test have not been digitized yet; the setup and the source pages are indexed. The setup below rests on two agent readings of the report that were reconciled; no person has checked it yet. The test setup is incomplete: relative density Dr, unit weight, tool, bin or mold, fill depth, control, rate are not reported.
:::
